root_idea.summary: A root orientation toward withdrawing out of sight, retreating, or becoming concealed.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends to celestial bodies that disappear or retrograde, the devil's withdrawal at divine mention, withholding or delaying, and physical recession or depression.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Quranic adjective and intensive active-participial epithet خَنَّاسٌ.
Displayed under the supported singular participial citation form خَانِسٌ; the Quranic occurrence is its substantivized plural خُنَّسٌ.

senses.definition: The one who withdraws, shrinks away, or hides when God is mentioned—namely, the devil.
senses.usage_conditions: An intensive epithet in مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ (114:4), describing recurrent withdrawal at the mention of God.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Active participle · substantivized in the plural

senses.definition: A retreating or concealed celestial body: a star or planet that disappears from view or retrogrades in its course.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ (81:15), the plural may refer broadly to stars or specifically to planets; their withdrawal is explained as setting, becoming hidden in daylight, or appearing to reverse course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw back, recede, remain behind, hold back, or lag behind; to withdraw from sight or shrink together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use, including withdrawal from a person or from a company of people; hiding or becoming absent belongs to the same withdrawal branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hide or conceal someone or something, or take it away so that it is no longer seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use, including the construction خَنَسَ بِهِ; the object may be a person or a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a star, to return or retrograde in its course, or to become hidden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized celestial use described as tropical in the lexical evidence; the Quranic substantivized plural is treated separately under the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of palm trees, to be delayed in receiving fecundation and consequently fail to bear fruit that year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing failure or delay of pollination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state or process of being or becoming depressed or lowered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general physical-result use, distinct from the more specific descriptions of the nose and sole of the foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Depression or recession of the nose bone, with the nose contracted or shortened and broad at the tip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific anatomical description of the shape of the nose, including recession toward the face or head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flatness in the hollow of the sole, with the foot fleshy there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use applied to the foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to recede, remain behind, or be delayed; to keep back, withhold, conceal, or make contract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes withholding part of someone's due and causing a person or thing to be left behind or hidden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where gazelles gather or take refuge for cover.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-name or place-description associated with gazelles and their covert.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having the characteristic depressed or receding nose; an epithet applied to certain animals, including gazelles, cattle, a tick, a lion, and a young pig.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal applications are conventional extensions of the nasal description; خَنْسَاءُ is also used of a wild cow, and a variant with ص is reported for the young-pig application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gazelles and bulls or cows, as an animal designation derived from the characteristic nasal form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural form is explicitly used for these animals; خَنْسَاءُ is additionally an epithet for the wild cow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of lean camels, patient of thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative use in the expression الإِبِلُ ضِمَّرٌ خِنَّسٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The three nights of the lunar month during which the moon withdraws from view.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional plural designation for these nights.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Turned-up or deflected at the points, said metaphorically of arrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of arrows repelled by the folds of a coat of mail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a foot, flat in the hollow of the sole and fleshy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival anatomical use, corresponding to the description of a foot as خَنِسَتْ.
